dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.intro.1__0.text: Your voice has come back to you, Ankou. Here, words are the only hands you have

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.intro.2__0.text: Water listens to a direction. Say flow, then west or east.

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.intro.3__0.text: The gallery is above us. Watch what the water carries before you ask it to move

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.nudge.Elev.text: The platform rides on the water. Where must the water go for it to come down to you?

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.nudge.Ladd.text: The ladder is rolled up above. There is another way to rise

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.nudge.NoLa.text: You stand between floors. Let the water choose your height

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.nudge.NotY.text: That word has no power here yet. In this room, only the water listens.

dialogue.anpu.teach-1-cistern.solve__0.w.text: You did not climb. You asked, and the water carried you

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.intro.1_.text: The mirror floats on the western raft. The raft rises only when the water goes west, and then your platform sinks

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.intro.2_.text: Some things must stay where they are after their support is gone. Say bind, then the thing you would hold

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.intro.3_.text: Bring the mirror to the gallery and leave nothing bound behind you

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.nudge.Bi.text: That thread carries the whole platform now. Give its weight back to the water first

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.nudge.El.text: You can only hold the platform while you stand on it, high in the shaft

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.nudge.Mi.text: The raft rises only with the water in the west. Can your platform stay high without the water?

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.nudge.No.text: That word has no power here yet. Hold. Release and move the water

dialogue.anpu.teach-2-held-step.solve__0.text: You held only as long as you needed to. Remember the feeling of letting go.

dialogue.anpu.teach-3-lingering-shadow.i.text: The far seal wants light. The near seal wants shadow. The gate ahead will ask for both at once
The sleeper stands in the beam and casts the shadow. Wake him, and he walks out of the light. His shadow follows him
Unless you hold it first, and you still hold two threads from before. Your voice can carry no more than two

dialogue.anpu.teach-3-lingering-shadow.n.text: That thread carries the platform. Give its weight to the water first
Your voice already holds two threads. Which one do you still need?
There is no shadow to hold. Perhaps its owner should rest again.
That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, wake, sleep, and move the water

dialogue.anpu.teach-3-lingering-shadow.s.text: The shadow stays, though its owner has gone. You will need this again
